infobox.effect: Provides 12 inventory slots while only taking up 4

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The Pistol case is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 12 inventory slots in a 4x3 grid and only takes up 4 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
- Pistols
- Revolvers
- Signal pistols
- Magazines
- Ammunition
